result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): The screenshots only show the first two or three questions of each quiz, so I couldn't check the submit button, scoring, wrong-answer feedback or missing-selection handling for either one. What is visible is very similar: both have well-grouped questions on load capacity and pedestrians with plausible options and no invented figures. A's layout is a bit tidier, while B's 'Question X of 5' labels make its question legends sit a little awkwardly on the card borders. Neither difference is enough to pick a winner. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both screenshots show the same kind of plain quiz: plausible questions on load limits and pedestrians, no extra features, and correct answers that point to the truck's capacity plate rather than invented figures.
